reviews.specification:
Implement contact-resistance-calibration v1 through the current handoff. Separate code reuse of hardness-assessment's specimen resolver, contact mechanics, debris conservation and surface inspection from this new absolute-measurement function. Public schema: {mode: 'inspect'|'sweep'|'assess'|'resume'|'cancel', target: string, counterface: string, project: string}; require all fields, reject extra properties, allow empty unused references. Shared reference semantics: target and counterface resolve explicit owned item IDs, never silently substitute resource types; project resolves an actor-owned persistent project. Dependencies: personal hardness-assessment mastery; actual distinct solid specimens with inspected usable surfaces; a versioned measurement model grounded in the world's existing contact mechanics. No reference stock, apparatus or certified specimen is created by implementation.
Before enabling absolute assessment, audit the existing contact law and publish its observable forward model, dimensional anchors, index mapping, uncertainty and identifiability limits. Force and pressure already recorded by the scratch handler may be used only where those records represent actual measured contact quantities; do not expose intrinsic material indices as readings. Never change material properties or redefine the >=8 predicate to make calibration succeed. If the model lacks independent anchors or has indistinguishable responses across the threshold, implement the sweep and an explicit unresolved result identifying the missing physical standard or measurement dependency; do not manufacture calibration lineage.
Inspect costs one round and 0.2 energy. Sweep reserves 0.1 unit from each specimen and performs four directional contacts, one per round at 0.5 energy, followed by one inspection round at 0.2 energy. Use two actual usable contact geometries and two measured force levels within the existing safe contact envelope; record achieved rather than merely requested values. Geometry that cannot be obtained from the supplied specimens produces an insufficient-geometry result, not a free prepared edge. Persist contact area/radius, force, pressure, dwell, grooves, transfer, wear, fracture, debris and uncertainty. Each contact executes existing physical mechanics and conserves all detached material. No contact may certify through resource names or comparison ranking alone. Assess costs one round and 0.2 energy and computes the full index interval compatible with all observations and the independently anchored model. Report supported >=8 only if the conservative lower bound is >=8, below-threshold only if its upper bound is <8, otherwise unresolved. A model with no finite supported bound returns null bounds. Results apply only to the tested material extent; do not certify its parent stack without independently supported homogeneity.

Migrate old comparisons unchanged as relative-only evidence, with null absolute bounds and no retroactive certification.
